text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up  Casey starts Tue. I sketched a "first-week sprint" checklist (very lean) so managers & HR know the minimal bar to hit. Pls review.

Dev (Eng Manager): Nice framing. My EOW goal: Casey ships a tiny change and demos it in the EOW sync. That gives confidence they touched code, CI, and review flow.

Rohan (HR): HR checklist: paperwork & direct deposit day0, benefits overview day2, enrollment reminder on day27. We'll keep the packet short.

Eve (IT): Need laptop choice + shipping addr. Also confirm whether we should require hardware MFA on day0 or allow software OTP for first login.

Casey (New Hire): MacBook Pro please. Address matches offer. OK with software OTP first day and we'll switch to hardware MFA once on-site.

OnboardBot: Welcome Casey! :tada: Created fast-track checklist: device order, Slack + GH invites, payroll forms, low-risk onboarding issue, security training link. Reminders set.

Dev (Eng Manager): Proposed "learning milestones" (30/60/90) to use in the EOW handoff:
- 30d: run dev env & merge onboarding PR (metric: merged PR + 1 positive review comment)
- 60d: deliver small feature change with tests (metric: story accepted + CI green)
- 90d: lead a short doc-update + present learnings (metric: doc PR + presentation)
Different from strict task lists; outcome-oriented.

Maya (People Ops): Ops asks: Dev please send calendar bundle (env setup, benefits, EOW demo). Eve: badge request if Casey will come in week2. Rohan: can you schedule the benefits slot day2?

Rohan (HR): Scheduled benefits 30-min on day2. I'll email Casey day0 with the packet. Also confirming enrollment window and contacts.

Eve (IT): Device ordered. Slack & GH invites queued. I'll enable software OTP first-login and tag for hardware MFA on-site. Badge request submitted (standard ETA 3-5 days).

Casey (New Hire): Got invites and packet. Appreciate the lean plan  excited to get started!

Dev (Eng Manager): I opened the onboarding issue and assigned the buddy: Lina from infra. EOW success criteria = joined core Slack, dev env functional, onboarding PR opened or merged, and security training started.

Maya (People Ops): Perfect  closing the loop. If anything blocks device >48h we escalate to Eve. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
